description: React Native component for a 'Rate and Review' screen allowing users to rate an order with stars and submit a textual review.

methods.name: onFinishRating
methods.description: Updates the rating state when user selects a star rating.

methods.name: onChangeText
methods.description: Updates the review description text state.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Submits the review if rating is valid, otherwise shows a message.

methods.name: onCompleted
methods.description: Handles successful review submission, navigates back.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors during review submission, shows error message.
